title: High Protein Salmon Salad
description: Creamy, crunchy salmon salad that takes about two minutes. Good on toast, crackers, wraps or jacket potatoes.

confidence.note: Amounts as given in the creator's caption. Not yet cooked and confirmed at home.

nutrition.note: As stated by the source; not independently checked.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Put the salmon ({{salmon}}), avocado ({{avocado}}), yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}), lemon juice ({{lemon}}) and cucumber ({{cucumber}}) in a bowl with salt, pepper, and hot sauce and dill if using. Mix well, breaking up the salmon as you go.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve on toast, crackers, wraps or jacket potatoes.
